subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should OpenClaw define a structured agent-facing usage contract on `session_status`, or keep raw usage data limited to Gateway usage RPCs/UI surfaces?
rationale: This changes the stable tool response surface and requires product decisions about privacy boundaries, availability/source metadata, cost semantics, and whether `session_status` is the right API owner.

options.title: Define narrow usage fields
options.body: Add a small additive `usage` object with session, last-turn, cost, budget/window availability, and source metadata while reusing existing Gateway/transcript usage code.

options.title: Keep usage in Gateway RPCs
options.body: Leave `session_status` as a rendered status card and document `sessions.usage` as the structured API for operator clients instead of agents.

options.title: Fold into broader metadata RFC
options.body: Defer this to the tool freshness/usage metadata design so `session_status` gets the same envelope as other cached tools.

recommendation.title: Define narrow usage fields
recommendation.body: Add a small additive `usage` object with session, last-turn, cost, budget/window availability, and source metadata while reusing existing Gateway/transcript usage code.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the `session_status` behavior and already provided prior maintainer-side review context on this issue.
